name: lgd
description: Unsecured LGD by seniority, collateral haircuts (CP-4.1) and recovery time, LGD floor, structure adjustment. Round D: lien_deposit is the haircut row of the Deposit requirement term (lien-marked cash collateral).
policy: CP-4.1 haircuts: cash 0%, real estate 30%, plant and equipment 45%, receivables 50%

lien_deposit.label: Lien-marked cash deposit (Deposit requirement term)
lien_deposit.basis: CP-4.1: cash held with the Bank under lien in the deal's currency, 0% haircut (Basel CRM, cash on deposit with the lending bank); max_pct is the optimiser's bound on a required deposit, steps_pct the levels it tries
